content:
**Gum drops** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A gray and black box with "radioactive gumdrops" written on the wrapper.

- Several can spawn at Tyler County Fairgrounds in the baskets on the back table in the Trick or Treat building.
- One can be found on the shelf next to the red toolbox in the shack at Site Alpha.
- Occasionally found in Coolers and Lunch Pails.
- Can be obtained at a prize terminal in Camden Park by redeeming five Mr. Fuzzy Tokens.
- One can be found at Freddy Fear's House of Scares.
- One can be found in the kitchen at the diner in Summersville.
- One in Radiant Hills.
